The work i nvolved is furnished below: 1.0 COOKING AND SERVING OF FOOD: Periodicity of the activity: Round the clock 1.1 Average occupancy is 30 per day (approx.) at NS/RR, 25 per day (approx.) at MTM/RR and 20 per day (appro x.) at BVRM/RR. Average occupancy is 118 per day (approx.) at VSKP/RR and 25 per day (approx.) at TUNI/R R Every occupant of the running room is eligible for three meals and one packed meal as per requirement in a period of 24 hours. Occupancy at running rooms may vary depending upon traffic and working patterns. 1.2 Cooking and serving of the standard vegetarian meal to be made available for supply in the Running/Rest Ro om dining hall is as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.3 Cooking and supply of the standard vegetarian meal in packed form for the outgoing ALPs/LPs/TMRs is to be arranged as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.4 Cooking and serving of breakfast to be made available for supply in the Running/Rest Room dining hall is as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.5 Cooking and supply of breakfast in packed form to the outgoing ALPs/LPs/TMRs is to be arranged as furnishe d in Annexure – AI. 1.6 The contractor has to supply the food items on demand, if made by the occupant, duly taking full payment for the items mentioned at Annexure-AII. 1.7 The contractor has to ensure the supply of meals, breakfast, tea, coffee items as per the timings/Periodicity as specified in the Annexure-AIII. Sufficient staff be available for collecting the food items from the counter a nd serving to the occupants at the table. 1.8 All the raw material like Rice, wheat, Oil, vegetables etc., should be of good quality and should comply with the list of raw materials mentioned at Annexure-AIV. All the raw material should be inspected and certified b efore using them for cooking by the concerned Railway Supervisors of the Running/Rest Rooms or an y other authorized Railway Representative nominated on his behalf by Railways. 1.9 Contractor should ensure that he does not use any stale items. 1.10 The contractor is responsible for arranging sufficient suppliers to meet the requirement of serving food as p er the instructions of concerned Railway supervisor and Running room Inspector (CLI/RRI/BZA). These counter foils are to be handed over to the concerned Railway Supervisor. Day wise i ssues of tokens are to be maintained in a register by the contractor for account of meal consumed and to be jointly signed by the contractor supervisor and concerned Railway supervisor. Crew from various divisions will avail food facilities at Running/Rest room. Supply of food /tea/Coffee in dining hall: usage of steel plates/steel glasses as applicable b. HP/BP/IOL shall only be used on commercial rates to ensure LPG availability and he must take al l precautionary measures as specified by the gas authorities and obtain gas bank/pipe line certification from the concerned authorities with periodical renewal of certificate before expiry of validity. Contractor is sole re sponsible for safe usage of LPG. (b) 237 no. of meals per 19 Kg cylinder for VSKP and TUNIRRs. 1. In case of loss of any linen due to the negligence of the contractor, a penalty will be recovered from the con 4.5 tractor as per relevant penalty clause in special conditions of contract. The persons deployed by the contractor for this purpose shall give the call to the con cerned crew round the clock by obtaining signature in the call book by the crew and also obtain food order if any so that the crew can pick up their connected train without the prospect of missing the train due to sleep . 5.2 If the contractor fails to perform the above duties, a penalty will be recovered from the contractor as per rel evant penalty clause in special conditions of contract. 6.0 Cleaning & maintenance of Running room including maintenance of garden (Bed rooms, toilets, bath rooms, circulating area etc.,) (Man power shall be arranged as per Price Schedule):

6.1 Cleaning:-Sweeping, cleaning and mopping/washing of bedrooms, store room, verandahs, pump houses an d generator rooms, sunshades, roofs of the buildings etc., available in the premises of various Running Roo ms/Rest Rooms. SCOPE OF WORK Name of the Work: Outsourcing of Maintenance and Housekeeping services, including arrangement of subsidized meals/food, Linen, at 1) Running Rooms/NS, MTM & Rest Room/BVRM, and 2) Running Room/VSKP & Rest Room/TUNI, for ALPs, LPs, TMRs f or a period of two years. At present, Running rooms are available at Narsapur, Machilipatnam with a bed capacity of 30, 32 Nos. resp ectively and Rest Room at Bhimavaram with a bed capacity of 20Nos.for Assistant Loco Pilots (ALPs), Loco P ilots (LPs), and Train Managers (TMRs). Also, Running room is available at Visakhapatnam with a bed capacity of 107 Nos. and Rest Room at Tuni wi th a bed capacity of 16 Nos. for Assistant Loco Pilots (ALPs), Loco Pilots (LPs), and Train Managers (TMRs) at present. The work has to be executed as per price schedule at Running/Rest Rooms i.e., Cooking and Serving of food to the occupants, watch & ward arrangement, issuing of linen to the occupants, Serving of train ordering cal ls to the occupants, cleaning and maintenance of running room including garden etc., and as per requireme nt of the concerned Railway supervisor for a period of two years as detailed in the price schedule. The work i nvolved is furnished below: 1.0 COOKING AND SERVING OF FOOD: Periodicity of the activity: Round the clock 1.1 Average occupancy is 30 per day (approx.) at NS/RR, 25 per day (approx.) at MTM/RR and 20 per day (appro x.) at BVRM/RR. Average occupancy is 118 per day (approx.) at VSKP/RR and 25 per day (approx.) at TUNI/R R Every occupant of the running room is eligible for three meals and one packed meal as per requirement in a period of 24 hours. Occupancy at running rooms may vary depending upon traffic and working patterns. 1.2 Cooking and serving of the standard vegetarian meal to be made available for supply in the Running/Rest Ro om dining hall is as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.3 Cooking and supply of the standard vegetarian meal in packed form for the outgoing ALPs/LPs/TMRs is to be arranged as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.4 Cooking and serving of breakfast to be made available for supply in the Running/Rest Room dining hall is as furnished in Annexure –AI. 1.5 Cooking and supply of breakfast in packed form to the outgoing ALPs/LPs/TMRs is to be arranged as furnishe d in Annexure – AI. 1.6 The contractor has to supply the food items on demand, if made by the occupant, duly taking full payment for the items mentioned at Annexure-AII. 1.7 The contractor has to ensure the supply of meals, breakfast, tea, coffee items as per the timings/Periodicity as specified in the Annexure-AIII. Sufficient staff be available for collecting the food items from the counter a nd serving to the occupants at the table. 1.8 All the raw material like Rice, wheat, Oil, vegetables etc., should be of good quality and should comply with the list of raw materials mentioned at Annexure-AIV. All the raw material should be inspected and certified b efore using them for cooking by the concerned Railway Supervisors of the Running/Rest Rooms or an y other authorized Railway Representative nominated on his behalf by Railways. 1.9 Contractor should ensure that he does not use any stale items. 1.10 The contractor is responsible for arranging sufficient suppliers to meet the requirement of serving food as p er the instructions of concerned Railway supervisor and Running room Inspector (CLI/RRI/BZA). He has to en sure that the premises within the kitchen, utensils, Chimney, Grinder, other electrical appliances etc., shall be kept in clean & tidy always and the food prepared is hygienic and tasty. Over all hygienic conditions in th e running room is to be ensured. 1.11 Complaints from occupants with respect to supply of un-hygienic /perished/sub-standard food will be viewed seriously and a penalty will be recovered from the contractor as per relevant penalty clause in special condit ions of contract. 1.12 The contractor shall arrange required manpower for proper cleaning of utensils/cutlery being utilized for cooki ng and serving purpose. He shall use proper cleaning agents and hot water so that utensils/cutlery etc., will b e in totally cleaned condition.

1.13 Contractor shall maintain separate utensils and cleaning regular maintenance of Gas stoves like replacemen t of burners, knobs etc., (except gas pipe line) properly for preparing food. 1.14 For cooking of food, sufficient cooks and assistants shall be deployed during day/ night i.e., round the clock f or cooking arrangement at Running rooms. They shall appear in neat and tidy condition duly wearing Hand g loves, Aprons and caps. Separate payments will not be made by Railways for cooking, serving & utensil clea ning staff etc., and it is inclusive (i.e., salaries as per minimum wages, EPF & ESI are inclusive in the cost of the food itself). 1.15 For serving of food at regular intervals including parcel of food items, the required man power should be arr anged by the contractor for smooth functioning of the work. They should appear in neat and tidy condition d uly wearing Hand gloves, Aprons and Caps. 1.16 Cleaning of Meals plates, Tiffin plates, Tea glasses and Kitchen equipments etc., is to be done at regular inte rvals and required man power also arranged by the contractor for smooth functioning of the work. 1.17 The contractor shall display the weekly menu at prime location of Running room in advance duly ensuring the repetition of same item not more than twice in a week. 1.18 The contractor shall supply tokens with counter foils printed with serial numbers so that the name of the cre w can be written. These counter foils are to be handed over to the concerned Railway Supervisor. Day wise i ssues of tokens are to be maintained in a register by the contractor for account of meal consumed and to be jointly signed by the contractor supervisor and concerned Railway supervisor. Crew from various divisions will avail food facilities at Running/Rest room. It is the responsibility of the contr 1.19 actor to ensure that the occupants are satisfied with the Meals arrangements. 1.20 Supply of food /tea/Coffee in synthetic/polythene material containing packing is prohibited a. Supply of food /tea/Coffee in dining hall: usage of steel plates/steel glasses as applicable b. Supply of food /tea/Coffee in packing: Package of food in food-grade aluminum foils and supply of t ea/coffee in the flasks brought by occupants. c. Supply of minimum 10 days reserve quantity of foils for food packing. 2.0 Provision for supply of LP Gas: The contractor shall arrange LPG Cylinders (Commercial cylinders only) and their refills.
